title: feat(plk1): plane-hug same-k holds at k=1: t=3 vs t=5
science: Introduces plane-hug pi = mu + cost 3 on a 3->3 hop whose destination has min_i|w_i|=1 (strictly stronger than rho3's exactly-two-unit clause). Scored only at k=1 on B_6: t=3 vs 5, 27>25, small-k bar kept; t(2,1,1)=8. This is the band's last new rule and it is left as an open head with no large-k score. I computed the answer it never got: pi == rho3 on every same-k pair k=1..14, so pi also buys no
